about_the_game:
BIT.TRIP is back as BIT.TRIP RERUNNER + RUNNER MAKER! The classic rhythm platformer just got revamped with new mechanics, trippy visuals, and a killer soundtrack – plus a level editor for aspiring game designers.

The RUNNER MAKER empowers players to create and share custom levels. Indulge your imagination as you adjust obstacles and shape beat-driven gameplay – and then share your levels with the community. Inspire and be inspired as your fellow designers explore this limitless rhythm gaming adventure.

Why have one soundtrack when you can enjoy eight? Every song from every BIT.TRIP title makes an appearance in BIT.TRIP RERUNNER + RUNNER MAKER! Keep an ear to the ground for your favorite chiptune beats from BEAT, CORE, VOID, FATE, FLUX, RUNNER, Runner2, and Runner3!



  • Brave 150+ obstacle-filled levels based on the classic games – each more challenging than the last.
  • Dive head-first into a trippy new art style powered by Unreal 5.
  • Enjoy a fully remixed soundtrack at unhealthy volume levels.
  • Create and share the levels of your dreams with RUNNER MAKER.
  • Uncover gaming artifacts in the Historical Gallery – with fun nods to the original game!
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Operating System: Windows 10 64-bit version
  • Processor: Quad-Core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 670 / AMD R9 280 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Bluetooth audio devices are strongly discouraged, as they cause audio delay.

  • OS: Operating System: Windows 10 64-bit version
  • Processor: Quad-Core Intel or AMD, 2.9 GHz or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
